name: Todoroki Kayo
source:
A highly capable freelance announcer who produces and hosts programs. As the mother of a one-year-old infant, she strives for the perfect balance between work and family life, attending the Yoyogi Housewives' Academy.

Also serving as the head of a television news program, she possesses a serious and rigid personality. Perhaps due to her almost excessive combination of talent and beauty, she gives off an intimidating aura that makes others hesitant to approach her.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106141&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
